thread:
Miguel: quick follow-up from the PM for the KV cache eviction postmortem — we flagged a recurring pattern across three incidents. need concrete owners & jira links so this doesn't sit in the backlog.
Priya: ok, i'll take lead on the root-cause investigation (R). creating a ticket now: RWD-8472. ETA EOD Fri for initial triage.
Sara: thanks. i'll own the monitoring/alerting work (A). will propose an alert with runbook and add it to RWD-8473.
Miguel: RACI check: Priya = R, Sara = A, Sam = C for infra changes, Leah = I (security/compliance signoff).
Sam: i can help with infra-side changes and test plan. putting a note on RWD-8472 with required kernel/logging tweaks.
Leah: I'll review the plan once the triage doc lands. FYI we might need a PRD update if it affects customer SLAs.
Priya: triage summary (short): reproduced KV eviction on node repro-3 using 1.2m token stream, saw memory fragmentation + concurrent GC spikes. snippet from node logs attached:
```
2026-03-18T14:12:02Z kafka-consumer-3 kernel: oom-killer invoked
2026-03-18T14:12:03Z redis[pid]: evicted key prefix=redwood:kv:cache:session
```
Priya: next steps in RWD-8472: (1) narrow down allocation pattern (2) instrument allocator with histo (3) test quantized model with same seq lengths. Sam can coordinate infra perf sandbox.
Miguel: timeline: triage -> patch -> canary -> full rollout. can we agree on 2-week window for a non-breaking patch?
Sam: 2 weeks sounds fine for a safe rollout. i'll schedule a small canary fleet for validation.
Sara: for alerts RWD-8473: baseline alert on cache eviction rate > 3/min for 5m, and a higher-severity page for >10/min. will add dashboards + runbook.
Miguel: ownership baton: Priya hands off to Sam after patch PR is merged; Sam will own rollout. Sara will own alerting & escalation play. Leah keep monitoring for compliance notes.
Priya: tagging ops-bot to create a weekly reminder until closure. @ops-bot please create a recurring 1hr sync every Tues for the action owners.
ops-bot: Created recurring event "PM KV-eviction remediation sync" starting 2026-03-24 09:00 PT, repeating weekly. Invitation sent to Priya, Sara, Sam, Leah, Miguel.
Leah: thx. small ask — can we add a gating criteria to the jira: no rollout until canary error rate <= baseline for 48h.
Miguel: agreed, add gating to both RWD-8472 and RWD-8473.
Sara: added gating to RWD-8473, note in comments.
Priya: draft PR linked in RWD-8472; asking for review from Sam and Miguel. assigning Sam as reviewer.
Sam: looking now. small nit on allocator param names, but LGTM otherwise. I'll merge once unit tests finish.
Miguel: final check — please add a short retro note in the postmortem doc about recurrence root cause and the new alerting thresholds, so ops rotation has context.
Priya: will update postmortem doc and mark action items as assigned. closing loop: target resolution by 2026-04-01. :thumbsup:
Sara: noted, will monitor alerts during canary and escalate if anything odd. :eyes:
Miguel: thanks everyone — leaving the thread open for any new blockers.
